400 error when the prompt exceeds the model's maximum context length

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
begin
  api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
  client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
  result = client.chat_async(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'Very long prompt that exceeds the context window...', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'gpt-4'))
rescue StandardError => error
  warn "#{error.class}: #{error.message}"
end
```
